content.text: {"differences":[{"name":"Fix recalled upfront","rule":"Does the agent's first-turn reasoning identify the fix (adding _op_priority = 10.001 to Poly) from memory of the upstream change, before investigating the code?","shown_by":"A","evidence":"Turn 1 thinking says it recognizes the standard sympy fix of adding `_op_priority = 10.001`; B derives it later in turn 7 after reading the code."},{"name":"Root-cause exploration","rule":"Does the agent trace the cause through the decorators and priority mechanism in several separate read-only steps before editing?","shown_by":"B","evidence":"B spends turns 1-10 grepping decorators.py, expr.py, polytools.py and matrices for _op_priority before editing in turn 11; A edits in turn 4."},{"name":"Edit method","rule":"Does the agent make the edit with a Python script doing string replacement rather than sed?","shown_by":"A","evidence":"A uses a python heredoc with s.replace in turn 4; B uses sed -i in turn 11."},{"name":"Test runner","rule":"Does the agent run tests with sympy's own bin/test runner rather than pytest?","shown_by":"A","evidence":"A runs `python -W ignore bin/test ...` in turns 5-11; B uses `python -m pytest`."},{"name":"Test scope breadth","rule":"Does the agent run test suites well beyond polys/core, such as integrals, solvers, printing, matrices, functions and series, and compare them with baseline?","shown_by":"A","evidence":"Turn 9 runs integrals, solvers, printing, matrices, functions and series before and after via stash and diffs the outputs; B only runs test_polytools and test_arit."},{"name":"Baseline comparison method","rule":"Does the agent compare failures against the unmodified base using git stash for specific failing tests one at a time?","shown_by":"B","evidence":"B stashes and reruns individual failing tests (test_factor_noeval, test_poly_matching_consistency, test_issue_5786, test_arit) in turns 18, 22, 25 and 28."},{"name":"Regression investigation","rule":"Does the agent identify a new test failure caused by its change (test_match) and examine why it fails?","shown_by":"A","evidence":"A notices test_match failing in turn 5, inspects the assertion and the match output in turns 6-7, and flags the conflict; B never sees it because it never runs sympy/core test_match."},{"name":"XPASS discovery","rule":"Does the agent notice that the fix turns an XFAIL test (test_poly_matching_consistency) into a pass?","shown_by":"A","evidence":"Turns 7-9 show the xpassed test and its issue #5514 context; B only sees that test fail under pytest in both baseline and patched runs."}]}
